artworks.title: Portrait of Madame de Nittis ("Attenzione")
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and lavis on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic etching of a woman, from head to slightly below the knees. She is seated in a relaxed pose, with her upper body slightly turned to her left side and her left arm resting over the back of a chair. The woman has detailed facial features, neat updo hair, and wears a long dress with elaborate details and layers. The background is plain without any visible objects or accessories.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Forest
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé [proof]
artworks.description: This image depicts a dense and intricate wooded landscape from a ground-level perspective. The artwork shows a maze of gnarled tree trunks on the left side that overlap and entwine. As the eye moves from left to right, a path is revealed meandering through the trees towards a clearing in the distance. The horizon is subtly defined with the sky meeting a far-off landscape, with the silhouettes of treetops against it. The etching technique is evident in the finely articulated lines and cross-hatching that create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on contrasts between dark and light to create drama and emphasis, and shadows and highlights add depth and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: A Hermit Saint
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of an elderly man with long hair and a lengthy beard, seated at a table. His face is marked with deep lines, and he is wearing a loose garment. In front of him, there is an open book with text on the pages, and he is holding a string of prayer beads in his left hand. A crucifix, a small container, and some fruit are on the table. The background features detailed foliage.

artworks.title: Bacchanal
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures gathered in a festive scene. The setting includes various satyrs and cherubic figures around a large urn. They are drinking from amphorae and relaxing in a pastoral environment. The background features trees and rocks, with a dog in the foreground. The artwork is detailed, depicting the texture of the stone, foliage, and the playful postures of each creature.

artworks.title: Pierre Mignard
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated half-length portrait of an individual in a finely carved and ornate chair. The person is facing forward with their body turned slightly to one side. Their facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and a focused expression. The individual has long, curly hair that falls past the shoulders. They are dressed in a heavy, elaborately draped garment with a visible cravat at the neck. In one hand, they hold a large portfolio or folder, and in the other, a stylus or thin baton. The background features a textured, patterned wall with drapery cascading down one side. Text at the bottom of the image identifies the figure as Pierre Mignard and provides additional context about his titles and roles.

artworks.title: Denoisel Reading in the Garden
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows most of a man's body as he reclines on a curved wooden bench. He is positioned in a relaxed manner, leaning back with one arm stretched across the top of the bench and the other arm bent, holding what appears to be a cigarette. He is wearing a suit and tie along with a hat that partially obscures his facial features. His facial expression is not entirely clear due to the angle of his head and the shadow cast by the hat. There is a book resting next to him on the bench. Surrounding him is a lush, leafy environment with thick foliage and trees, creating a shaded area above the bench. In the background, slightly blurred, is a figure of a woman walking, partially visible through the dense greenery. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: A Deception
artworks.medium: pen and black, iron gall, and colored inks with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Max and Heidi Berry

artworks.title: Dr. Ludwig Binswanger (Kopf Dr. Ludwig Binswanger)
artworks.medium: Woodcut on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Nelson Blitz, Jr., and Catherine Woodard in honor of Perri and Allison Blitz
artworks.description: The artwork depicts an abstract image of a person's head and partial shoulders. It is centered and angled slightly to the right, emphasizing angular and geometric features with sharp contrasts of black and white. The person's hair has spiked and jagged edges, and their facial features are exaggerated with almond-shaped eyes, a long and narrow nose, and distinct lips. Lines and patterns on the face add detailed texture. Geometric patterns around the shoulders suggest clothing. The background is a plain, neutral tone.

artworks.title: The Demon Printer
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint

artworks.title: Grotto with Friars
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the inside of a cavern. The etching uses fine, crosshatching lines to depict rocky surfaces and details within the cave. The entrance of the cave is bright, contrasting with the darker interior. Detailed textures are visible in the cave walls and floor. Two figures are inside the cave, one standing and one sitting. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white to depict light and shadow, with a strong emphasis on light within the cavern.

artworks.title: The Bookplate of the Printer's Devil
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and shapes forming a complex abstract artwork. A large circular shape is at the center, surrounded by curvilinear forms connecting different elements. Objects like books are visible within the setting. Ribbons and drips interlace in the upper section, with human-like figures interspersed throughout. The arrangement creates an otherworldly atmosphere with surreal and fantastical imagery.

artworks.title: The Bookplate of the Printer's Devil
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains intricate swirling lines forming complex tapestries of shapes and forms. A large face resembling a mythical creature with pointed ears and a crown stands out among various smaller figures and cherubic children. The left and right edges feature fantastical creatures, while the upper and lower edges show rolling scrolls or banners. The overall composition evokes a whimsical, fantastical scene.

artworks.title: The Bookplate of the Printer's Devil
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ex libris design. The scene includes a central face with intricate details, surrounded by clouds, scrolls, and decorative elements. Books and a quill are present, along with mythical creatures and allegorical figures. The drawing is signed and dated in the bottom right corner, showcasing the detailed and imaginative style typical of personalized ex libris designs from the period.

artworks.title: Bildnis Dr. Gr.
artworks.medium: lithograph on blue-green japan paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract illustration of an upper body representation of a person. The person is shown in a distorted form, leaning forward with their head tilted slightly downwards and arms partially visible. The facial features are exaggerated and stylized, including prominent eyes, an elongated nose, and lips. The hair is depicted in a sweeping manner. The focus is on the form and contours of the body, with no emphasis on clothing, jewelry, or objects. The background is textured, monochrome, and abstract, enhancing the overall artistic expression.

artworks.title: A Pastoral Landscape with a Stream
artworks.medium: monotype in dark brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wide sky, trees, a rustic fence, and a marshland. The horizon is near the lower third, featuring trees and a fence. The sky has dispersed clouds, while the foreground includes a marsh reflecting the sky. The colors are mainly sepia tones, creating a vintage look.

artworks.title: Evening on a River with a Boatman
artworks.medium: monotype in black and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, trees, and a house in the distance. The painting features a monochromatic color palette with soft brushstrokes creating a serene atmosphere. There is a boat on the river, and the composition guides the viewer's eye through the scene.

artworks.title: A Sun-dappled Meadow by a River
artworks.medium: monotype in brownish black ink on laid Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil landscape with a smooth, reflective body of water in the foreground. Beyond the water is grassy land leading to a line of trees and shrubs forming a low horizon. Delicate brushstrokes create texture in the trees and grass, suggesting movement and stillness. The monochromatic color palette uses various shades of gray for a serene atmosphere. The sky is soft and expansive, with subtle variations indicating a calm day.

artworks.title: Interior of Room
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: We look toward the far end of a large, well-appointed room at a person reading in an armchair and a woman wearing a long dress standing in front of a fireplace in this horizontal photograph. The image is monochromatic like a black and white photograph but is printed in warm tones of golden and dark browns. Both people have light skin. An expanse of carpet patterned with light flowers against a dark background stretches from where we are to the opposite end of the room. Furniture lines the walls to either side of us, including a desk to our left and a tall cabinet to our right. The scene is lit by ceiling-high windows or doors along the wall to our left. Two armchairs, a chaise, a loveseat, and a sofa, all covered with fabric patterned with dark roses against a light background, are arranged at the far end of the room. A person with short dark hair, wearing a light suit, sits facing away from us, reading a book in an armchair to our left. One hand rests up by the ear we can see, brushing the smooth cheek. The woman standing at the fireplace, facing away from us, wears a white cap on dark hair, and a floor-length, dark dress. The dress has a high, white collar and white cuffs at the end of long sleeves. It is belted at the narrow waist and falls in deep folds, in a wide A-line to the floor. The mantle is lined with a clock and figurines under glass cases. The large, ornately framed mirror fills the height of the wall between the fireplace and the ceiling, which is lined with molding. Other tables set against walls and in front of some of the seating is topped with pictures, figurines, books, plants, and lamps. Cases with small tchotchkes hang on the wall to either side of the large mirror, and other plaques and pictures hang on the walls. The mirror reflects a sliver of the standing woman’s face, showing downcast or closed eyes, a rounded nose, and closed lips. The wall behind us is also reflected in the large mirror, and shows more hanging pictures.

artworks.title: The Artist's Brother-in-Law, Ludwig Hassenpflug, Preparing to Play the Piano
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a side profile of a person seated at a keyboard instrument. The person is focused on playing, with hands positioned on the keys. They have short, dark hair styled upwards. The individual wears a long garment with a high collar and furry trim. The chair has a simple design, and the instrument has decorative carvings. Sheet music is open on the instrument. The background shows patterned wallpaper and a partial view of foliage outside the window.

artworks.title: Glacial Boulders at the Edge of a Mountain
artworks.medium: graphite on light blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew and Pauline Robison
artworks.description: The sketch shows a landscape with large rock formations dominating the scene. The rocks are positioned prominently, with a sloping terrain leading to the left. In the left part of the drawing, the horizon meets a distant, vaguely defined skyline or mountain range. Delicate pencil strokes are used to outline the rocks and sparse vegetation, creating a textured look. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily using shades of gray. The composition is simple, with gentle tones in the rock surfaces and landscape, creating a serene and contemplative effect.

artworks.title: Sunlit Trees Before a Panoramic Landscape
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew and Pauline Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a large tree dominating the left side, with a low horizon and hills or mountains in the distance. The tree is detailed with textured bark and delicate branches, rendered in light pencil strokes. White highlights suggest blossoms or light filtering through the leaves. The background is mostly empty, emphasizing the detailed tree. The color palette is mainly shades of gray with warm undertones from the paper.

artworks.title: Study of Clouds above the Mountains
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew and Pauline Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon slightly above the center, featuring a line of fluffy clouds in the sky. The clouds are illustrated with soft brushstrokes, giving them a light quality. The artwork is monochromatic, using variations of black and white on a beige background. The ground is textured with linear strokes, suggesting fields or a hill. In the distance, minimalistic cloud forms are scattered. Handwritten notations are visible across the sky and land.

artworks.title: Sunset above a Mountain Lake
artworks.medium: black chalk on thin wove paper from a ledger book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew and Pauline Robison
artworks.description: The image is viewed from an elevated perspective, overlooking a landscape scene. The horizon is partially hidden by hills or mountains in the distance. Stylized pencil strokes depict clouds in the sky and a radiant sun emits streaks of light. Trees in the foreground are drawn with dense, swirling pencil marks for texture and depth. The style is sketch-like, with visible lines adding dynamism. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of gray and black, creating subtle contrast in the landscape.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a stylized person in a reclining position on their side. The person's entire body is shown with both arms under their head. The face has closed eyes, arched eyebrows, a small nose, and mouth. The hair is represented by bold lines. The figure is nude with defined curves and contours. There are no visible clothing details, jewelry, or objects being held. The background features swirling black lines for movement against a light-colored backdrop.
